about.heading: Turning ideas into digital reality
about.body: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience building GCC enterprise systems that process thousands of shipments daily across Oman, UAE, and Saudi Arabia. I lead the AI program at one of Oman's largest logistics platforms — shipping RAG chatbots and AI copilots used daily by operations teams — and I founded AI Caller, a multi-tenant SaaS where businesses get an AI receptionist that answers real phone calls with knowledge-grounded, hallucination-resistant responses.
